entry.title: Kuka Cosmetics — Visual Identity
entry.summary: The visual identity and packaging system for Kuka was developed to communicate clarity, freshness, and modern self-care. The design relies on a minimal typographic hierarchy, soft pastel color coding, and clean cylindrical packaging to create strong shelf recognition while differentiating each scent variant such as Secret Grove, Coconut Breeze, Glow Desire, Twilight Mist, and Desert Bloom. The visual language balances elegance with approachability: bold serif fragrance names provide character, while the restrained logo and simplified layout maintain a premium yet accessible aesthetic. Across body lotion, hand wash, and shower gel, the consistent bottle silhouette and color palette build a cohesive product family that feels contemporary, calm, and distinctly memorable in retail and campaign visuals.

entry.title: Folded Paper Texture Pack
entry.summary:
Folded Paper Texture Pack is a collection of high-resolution scanned paper textures designed to add realistic folds, creases, grain, and worn analog character to digital artwork. The pack has a dark, tactile, editorial feel, making it suitable for designers who want to bring physical paper depth and distressed surface detail into clean digital compositions.
The set includes 30 folded paper textures in JPG format, each supplied at 6250 × 8700 px for large-scale and high-detail use. These textures work well as overlays, backgrounds, poster surfaces, collage materials, branding accents, and atmospheric finishing layers for both print and digital projects.
